metadata.name: status-report-draft
metadata.description: Draft a weekly project status report by reading Linear + GitHub + Slack + GCal across the last 7 days. LOCKED at L3 (still always-approval at L3; autonomous send only at L4).
metadata.unlock_requirement: Promote worker to L3; status_report.send remains approval-gated until L4.

kind.template: Invoke linear-read (last 7d), github-read (last 7d), and gcal-read (last 7d). Bundle into WeekWindow.
Sections: shipped, in-flight, at-risk, decisions logged this week, blockers needing exec attention, next week. Cite source links per bullet. Tone-matched.

nodes.label: Publish approved report (Slack post or email)

kind.instruction: Post the approved draft to the configured status-report channel/recipients; log to communication_log.
